norms.density_fixedpoint: sqrt(dvol)*norm(n_out-n_in); never multiply the acceptance residual by alpha
norms.mixing_step: sqrt(dvol)*norm(n_mixed-n_in); n_mixed=(1-alpha)*n_in+alpha*n_out. Actual n_next uses candidate n_out for the explicit closure map, otherwise n_mixed; record its step separately.
norms.pauli_relative: norm(m)/norm(n), strictly positive measured spinor valence charge-density norm
norms.orbitals: component-interleaved ComplexF64; component norms sum to one per state
